name: io.github.Muao/innate-date-search
title: Innate Date
description: Compare dates by numerology scores across up to 30 days. For symbolic exploration.

tools.name: find_dates
tools.description: Return up to five highest-scoring dates in an inclusive range of 1-30 days, using the calculator’s numerology methodology for symbolic exploration. Do not use these scores for medical scheduling or health predictions. Supports 1900-01-01 through 2100-12-31. Scores sort descending; ties use earliest date. A longer range is rejected, never truncated. No broader search or continuation is provided.

start.description: First calendar date, inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD. Earliest allowed: 1900-01-01.

end.description: Last calendar date, inclusive. At most 30 calendar days including start and end. Latest: 2100-12-31.

criterion.description: Score to maximize; defaults to total.
